presentation.label: MACHINE BROWSER
presentation.summary: Browse the machine list without loading each machine, and jump between its sections with FUNC + UP or DOWN. YES loads.
presentation.overview: Stock loads every machine the machine list's outline passes, so the track's sound and SRC page change while you scroll. Here UP, DOWN and the knobs only move the outline: nothing loads until YES, and NO leaves the track as it was. FUNC + DOWN jumps to the first machine of the next section (BD, SD, SY and so on), and FUNC + UP to the top of the current section, then of the one above.
highlights: Scroll the machine list without changing the track's sound
YES loads the outlined machine, NO changes nothing
FUNC + UP or DOWN jumps between the list's sections
Knobs A-H browse as the arrows do, with FUNC for sections
usage: Press SRC twice to open the machine list on the BD track.
Press DOWN a few times: the outline moves and the header asks Confirm? Y/N, but the BD keeps its machine and its SRC page.
Press FUNC + DOWN: the outline jumps to SY DUAL VCO, the first machine of the next section. FUNC + UP goes back to the top of the BD section.
Press YES: the outlined machine loads and the list closes. Open it again, scroll and press NO: nothing changed.

access.location: The machine list: SRC pressed twice, or FUNC + SRC.
steps: Open the machine list with SRC pressed twice.
UP and DOWN, or a turn of any knob A-H, move the outline one machine without loading it.
FUNC + DOWN or FUNC + UP jumps between sections. YES loads the outlined machine, NO closes the list unchanged.

limitations: Tapping the track's pad in the list plays the machine the track has, not the outlined one: press YES to hear a machine.
Sections are the list's own dotted lines: with the Modwerk base's machine list sections, a mod machine sits in its section; without them it sits above BD.
